taxonomic_levels.LEVEL_0: Street / neighborhood only (Nominatim / OSM without door numbers)
taxonomic_levels.LEVEL_1: Street + house number (Geocoded address points without lot/cadastral binding)
taxonomic_levels.LEVEL_2: Street + house number + lot identifier / subdivision block
taxonomic_levels.LEVEL_3: Street frontage / corner description / confrontation (Direct face binding)
taxonomic_levels.LEVEL_4: Parcel geometry or subdivision blueprint map position
taxonomic_levels.LEVEL_5: Direct municipal cadastral identifier <-> spatial vector parcel mapping

source_families.description: Municipal official gazette publishing notices of building inspections (fiscalização de obras), Habite-se concessions, IPTU Active Debt (Dívida Ativa), zoning approvals, and administrative notifications.
source_families.machine_readable: PARTIALLY (PDF text layer / HTML index, no CAPTCHA)
source_families.document_count_estimate: Over 1,000 gazette editions containing tens of thousands of notices
source_families.cadastral_binding_type: EXPLICIT (contains municipal BC alongside address, lot, and subdivision block)
